## Permit Clause
Anyone with a valid permit cannot have the relevant contraband seized and cannot be arrested for possession. A valid permit is outlined in [textlink="Permit Acquisition" link="security-sop-permitacquisition"].
If an individual possesses an Origin stamp but lacks the other required stamps, they may be escorted to the person needing to stamp their form if the item was found during a random search. If the item was found during a search conducted due to a crime, an Origin stamp is not enough if the permit is not valid with that stamp alone, and the item may be confiscated.
